name: spec-kit
description: Rules for the personal spec-kit template (template/spec-template.md), classified from the template and its Arabic guide (README-ar.md). Structure and the four rules the guide labels 'القاعدة' are mandatory; the guide's questions and common-mistake tips are advisory. Numeric guidance in the guide (how many FRs, out-of-scope items or ACs) is non-binding and deliberately not encoded.

patterns.message: write the user story as: As a …, I want to … so that ….
write each acceptance criterion as: Given …, when …, then ….
patterns.source: template §4; guide §4 (write every criterion in this form)

tables.message: every edge case needs a scenario and a specific expected behavior.
tables.source: template §2; guide §2 rule (every edge case must have a specific behavior)

judgment.source: guide §1 (القاعدة): every FR must be testable

judgment.rule: Every edge case has a specific behavior
judgment.source: guide §2 (القاعدة): 'handles the error' is not a behavior

judgment.rule: Proposed classes, use cases and layers are based on the inspected project and cite the code they follow; the user reviews and approves them
judgment.source: guide §3 (القاعدة), adjusted: the AI proposes from the inspected code instead of asking the user to write the names

judgment.rule: Every requirement can be verified by an acceptance criterion, edge case, Done-when item or named test
judgment.source: guide §4 (القاعدة): if you cannot write an acceptance criterion, go back to section 1

questions.concurrent-change: Someone else changes the same data at the same moment (another driver, seller, admin)
questions.stale-data: Data changed since the user saw it (price, stock, fees)
questions.lost-response: The request succeeded but the response was lost

advisory.message: Name the required tests in Done when.
Out of scope says None; list what an agent might wrongly think is required.
advisory.source: guide: common mistakes (leaving Out of scope empty)

prompts: When does each button appear and disappear?
Where does the data come from, and who computes it: the server or the app?
Which files and modules must the agent not touch?
Which interfaces and APIs must stay as they are?
Who decides the business rules: the server or the app?
